description: This file defines the 'NodeTraverser' class in the Twig templating engine, which manages visiting nodes in an abstract syntax tree and applying visitor patterns during traversal.

classes.name:
Twig
ode_traverser
classes.description: A class responsible for traversing nodes in Twig's abstract syntax tree and applying registered visitors.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the NodeTraverser with an environment and optional list of visitors.

methods.name: addVisitor
methods.description: Registers a new visitor to be applied during node traversal.

methods.name: traverse
methods.description: Traverses the given node and its children, applying all registered visitors.

methods.name: traverseForVisitor
methods.description: Applies a specific visitor to a node and its children during traversal.
